entries.german: König Johann bezahlt die demPeter von Rosenberg schuldigen Geldsummen namentlich mit einerAnweisung auf die Berggefälle in Kuttenberg. 1 - Johannes dei gratia Boemiae rex, Lucemburgensis comes, harum serie recognoscimus universis, quod nos fideli nostro dilecto Petro de Rosenberch de nostris debitis satisfacere volentes, sibi in summa sexagenarum trium milium nongentarum septuaginta quinque grossorum denariorum Pragensium, quas eidem Petro et heredibus suis per ratiocinia secum nuper habita remasimus (remansimus) debiti, per has particulares summas, et primo in summa remanente, quam prius de vrbora Cuthnae 2 percipere debebat, mille quadringentas septuaginta sexagenas; item pro Sdeslao de Sterenberch 3 centum sedecim sexagenas; item pro Merclino Judaeo de Crumnov 4 centum sexagenas; pro Nycol. Rochiczanero de Praga centum triginta quinque sexagenas; pro Conczlino Judaeorum iudice de Praga pro obstagiis octoaginta unam sexagenas; pro Frenczlino Tauelron de Praga pro obstagio viginti unam sexagenas minus decem grossis; pro Sopussio de Praga pro obstagio decem sexagenas minus duodecim grossis; item pro disbrigatione bonorum Bauari 5 septingetas (septingentas) sexagenas; item pro exsolutione castri Protyuin 6 ducentas quadraginta sexagenas; item pro disbrigatione bonorum monasterii Sanctae Coronae centum octoaginta 7; item pro villis Radossouitz, Zabobrziesk et Dehtars quadringentas viginti sexagenas; item pro exsolutione nemorum Kamicensium 8 quingentas sexagenas, in quibus quidem particularibus summis infrascriptas summas dicto Petro et heredibus suis deputavimus percipiendas. 9 Primum siquidem in provintiis Prachinensi et Bechinensi de berna generali 10, quam ibidem percepit et percipiet, mille ducentas sexagenas. Et in villicatione Piestensi 11 de censibus beati Galli praeteriti et beati Georgii futuri proxime et de aurifodinis 12 quingentas sexagenas. Et in villicatione Kamicensi trecentas triginta sexagenas per ipsum Petrum et heredes suos percipiendas et habendas in solutionem nostrorum debitorum. Residuas autem mille nongentas quadraginta quinque sexagenas, quas sibi debiti remansimus, in proventibus vrborae nostrae in Cuthnis sibi etiam deputamus taliter, quod incipiendo in octava epyfaniae hodie celebratae praefatus Petrus et heredes sui de praedictis proventibus in Cuthna singulis ebdomadis continuis marcas viginti regalis pagamenti percipere et habere debeant sine intermissione aliqua tam diu, donec de praedictis mille nongentis quadraginta quinque sexagenas fuerit plene solutus. Eo tamen interiecto, quod si idem Petrus in perceptione dictarum marcarum viginti quatuor septimanis continuis ex quacunque occasione vel causa fortassis inpediretur, extunc defectus ille qui ex huiusmodi solutionis negligentia evenerit, in quinta septimana inmediate sequente sibi debet totaliter persolvi. Sincere etiam promittimus cum provisoribus vrborariisque monetae in Cuthnis praesentibus et futuris velle, procurare et efficere, ut dicto Petro promittant, eumque assecurare debeant singulis septimanis de dictis marcis viginti solvendis et assignandis eidem. Quibus quidem provisoribus exnunc praecipiendo iniungimus, ut iuxta modum praemissum praedicto Petro praedictas marcas viginti dare debeant nec eum in perceptione earum inpediant seu inpediri sinant quoquo modo. Et si praefatum Petrum in solutione dictarum viginti marcarum quatuor septimanis continuis et etiam in quinta sequente septimana per quemcunque modum inpediri contingat, extunc volumus sibi faventes, ut ipse de bonis villarum videlicet Pystyn et Zablatie 13 cum omnibus earum iuribus et pertinentiis eo modo, iure et tytulo quibus sibi prius pignori obligatae fuerant, se intromittere debeat per eum habendas, possidendas et utifruendas fructibus in sortem principalem pecuniae minimae computatis tam diu, donec sibi vel heredibus suis de summa praedicta, in qua defectum passus est, per nos vel heredes nostros plene fuerit satisfactum. Adicientes insuper, si dictus Petrus de Rosenberch in berna dictarum pecuniarum ultra mille ducentas sexagenas sibi deputatas perceperit; id superhabundans per eum perceptum in perceptione dictarum viginti marcarum septimanatim in Cuthnis compensari debet et omnino defalcari, et e converso, si dicto Petro in deputationibus sibi factis in provinciis et villicationibus praedictis aliquod deperiret, id in dictis proventibus in Cuthnis septimatim per viginti marcarum perceptionem ut praedictum est suppleri sibi volumus et refundi. Praeterea si in posterum rationabili et evidenti documento appareret, nos ultra dictas summas dicto Petro in aliquo esse obligatos, id in saepedictis proventibus in Cuthnis per dictam viginti marcarum septimalem perceptionem sibi volumus et promittimus deputare, Harum serie et testimonio litterarum. Datum Pragae anno domini millesimo trecentesimo tricesimo sexto, in festo epyfaniae eiusdem. Auf dem Umbug links : . Per. d. regem.W.
entries.english:
King John pays the sums of money owed to Peter von Rosenberg, specifically with an assignment on the mining revenues in Kuttenberg. 1 - John by the grace of God King of Bohemia, count of Luxembourg, we acknowledge through this document to all that we, wishing to satisfy our faithful beloved Peter of Rosenberg from our debts, in the total sum of sixty-three thousand nine hundred seventy-five groats of denarii Prague, which remained owed to said Peter and his heirs through accounts recently held with him, through these particular sums, and first in the remaining sum which he previously should have received from vrbora Kutna, one thousand four hundred sixty grooms; also for Sdeslao of Sterenberch one hundred sixteen grooms; also for Merclino the Jew of Crumnov one hundred grooms; for Nycol.Rochiczaner of Prague one hundred thirty-five grooms; for Conczlino judge of the Jews of Prague for pledges eighty-one grooms; for Frenczlino Tauelron of Prague for a pledge twenty-one grooms minus ten groats; for Sopussio of Prague for a pledge sixteen grooms minus twelve groats; also for the release of the goods of Bauari seven hundred grooms; also for the payment of the castle Protyuin two hundred forty grooms; also for the release of the goods of the monastery of Saint Clare one hundred eighty; also for the villages Radossouitz, Zabobrziesk and Dehtars four hundred twenty grooms; also for the release of the woods of Kamicensium five hundred grooms, in which particular sums we have assigned to said Peter and his heirs to be collected.First indeed in the provinces of Prachinensi and Bechinensi from the general berna, which he collected and will collect there, twelve hundred grooms.
And in the stewardship of Piestensi from the censuses of Saint Gall past and Saint George coming soon and from the gold mines five hundred grooms.And in the stewardship of Kamicensi three hundred thirty grooms to be collected by himself and his heirsThe remaining one thousand nine hundred forty-five grooms, which remained owed to him, we also assign to said Peter from the revenues of our mining operation in Kuttenberg, as follows: starting from the octave of Epiphany celebrated today, aforesaid Peter and his heirs shall receive and hold from the aforesaid revenues in Kuttenberg twenty marks of royal currency per week continuously without any interruption for as long as they are not fully paid from the aforesaid one thousand nine hundred forty-five grooms.Provided nevertheless that if aforesaid Peter should happen to be prevented for twenty-four consecutive weeks from receiving the aforesaid twenty marks for any occasion or cause, then the deficiency that arises from such negligence in payment shall be entirely paid to him in the fifth week immediately following.We also sincerely promise with the present and future provisors and officials of the coinage at Kuttenberg to will, procure and ensure that they promise said Peter and shall assure him to give and assign to him every week the aforesaid twenty marks.To these same provisors we now command and enjoin that according to the aforementioned manner they shall give the aforesaid twenty marks to said Peter and not hinder or allow to be hindered in any way his receipt of them.
And if aforesaid Peter should happen to be prevented in any way from receiving the payment of the twenty marks for four consecutive weeks and also in the fifth following week, then we wish to favor him so that he shall be entitled to take possession of, hold, possess and enjoy the fruits of the goods of the villages namely Pystyn and Zablatie with all their rights and appurtenances in the same manner, right and title by which they had previously been pledged to him, computing the fruits toward the principal sum of money, for as long as he or his heirs are fully satisfied from the aforesaid sum, in which he has suffered loss, by us or our heirs.Furthermore we add that if aforesaid Peter von Rosenberg should receive beyond the twelve hundred grooms assigned to him from the berna of the aforesaid money; what he receives in excess shall be credited and entirely deducted from his weekly receipt of the twenty marks at Kuttenberg, and conversely, if anything should be lost to said Peter in the assignments made to him in the aforementioned provinces and stewardships, we wish and order that it be supplemented and refunded to him from the aforesaid revenues at Kuttenberg through the receipt of twenty marks weekly as aforesaid.Moreover if in the future it should appear by reasonable and evident documentation that we are obligated beyond the aforesaid sums to said Peter in any respect, we wish and promise to assign it to him from the aforesaid revenues at Kuttenberg through the weekly receipt of twenty marks.With these letters as witness and testimony.Given at Prague in the year of our Lord one thousand three hundred thirty-six, on the feast of Epiphany thereof.On the fold flap left: By order of the king.W.
